title: Grateful Dead Live at Rochester Community War Memorial on 1973-03-30

ai_review.summary: Half soundboard, half audience tape delivers a solid SBD second half with a smoking Truckin' > Eyes of the World jam and standout Keith keyboard work.
ai_review.review: The recording is a split‑deck (matrix) where the soundboard feed kicks in from Playin’ onward and sounds clean, while the earlier audience portion is muddy and hum‑ridden. Musically the show shines in the second set – China Rider’s groovy transition, a hot Truckin' jam that morphs into Eyes of the World, plus excellent 1973 Keith piano/organ work make it a must‑hear for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about the performance outweigh the noted audience‑tape issues, leading to a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard portion (Playin' onward) is clean and well‑balanced; earlier audience segment is sketchy, muddy, with a hum and occasional unlistenable sections.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set is uneven due to poor audience recording, but from Playin' the show gains momentum – concise PITB, a groovy China Rider transition, solid Greatest, and a standout Truckin' > Eyes of the World jam that defines the classic early‑73 upstate vibe.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's piano/organ work is highlighted as hot and interesting, especially during the Truckin' jam and quiet, moody sections.
